Subject: Quick intake: Optimarc signup — next steps

Team,

Heads up — Optimarc (Sasha Iverson) just finished a self-serve trial signup and flagged customer support triage + semantic retrieval as the primary use case. Summary from the signup:

- Contact: Sasha Iverson, Head of AI Integrations (sasha@optimarc.com)
- Use case: support ticket triage, retrieval from knowledge base, few-shot classification for routing
- Approx expected volume: 50k–150k requests/month (they selected mid-tier in the form)
- Timeline: exploring a pilot in Jan 2028; want a demo before holiday break
- Requirements flagged: Okta SSO, SOC2 evidence, EU data residency question (they're US-based but ask about future EU ops)

I attached the signup_record.pdf from the form. Ben — can you run quick qualification, propose 2–3 demo windows next week, and capture any additional integration asks? Laura / Monica — please loop in if you want to attend the demo (SE / CS).

Key Qs to surface in first outreach (short list we can refine):
- Primary API pattern (chat vs. embeddings vs. retrieval)
- Typical prompt length, expected tokens per request, and concurrency/peak QPS
- Any compliance/hard reqs beyond SOC2 (e.g., contractual SLAs, e-discovery)
- PII concerns or data ingestion methods (S3, API, connectors)

Thanks — rohan

--

Hi Sasha — congrats on getting started with the trial, and thanks for signing up. I’m Ben on the Redwood team (SDR/AE support). Quick intro and two-short-questions before we lock a demo:

1) What’s the primary flow you want to demo first? (customer support triage only, retrieval + reranking, or a combined assistant flow)
2) Expected steady-state traffic and peak concurrency — ballpark daily/monthly requests and any peak QPS you anticipate?

We usually do a 25–30 minute walk-through focused on ramp, latency, and cost for your expected footprint. Proposed windows (all PT):
- Wed Nov 10 — 10:00–10:30
- Wed Nov 10 — 14:00–14:30
- Thu Nov 11 — 11:00–11:30

If none of those work, reply with a preferred slot or pick here: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min?month=november

Also attaching a small pre-demo traffic template (pre-demo-traffic-template.csv) — if you can share a filled sample it’ll save time during the call.

Thanks — looking forward to learning more.

Best,
Ben Carter

Hi Ben — thanks for reaching out. Quick answers below to help scope the call:

- Primary flow: start with retrieval + semantic search for KB articles, then a follow-up to look at routing/triage.
- Volume: currently ~60k requests/month; we expect to grow to ~120k/month across Q1 if pilot goes well.
- Peak concurrency: about 8–12 requests/sec during morning support spikes.
- Auth/integration: we use Okta SSO and push ingestion via S3 and an internal ETL; would like to understand onboarding for data connectors.
- Compliance: SOC2 is required; interested in retention controls and audit logs (who can view requests).
- Timeline: pilot target Jan 2028; prep in December preferred.

The Thu Nov 11 11:00 PT slot looks good for a 30-minute demo. Laura / Rohan — please feel free to add whoever needs to be on the call.
